pins.definition: A flying insect that produces honey and lives in hives.
A small yellow-and-black flying insect that collects nectar and makes honey.
A flying insect that has yellow and black stripes and makes honey.

situation: A gardener in a sunny backyard leans close to inspect the yellow and black insect hovering directly over an open lavender blossom.
subject: the honey-making insect
brief: A single yellow-and-black striped insect hovers sharply in the center of the frame, suspended over the pale purple petals of a lavender bloom.
